notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded Local Delete Object Instance implementation to the exact official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador declaration exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies the signature, declared exception set, adapter symbol, and real Catch2 selectors. The behavior test proves connection/membership and known-instance boundaries, FederateOwnsAttributes and OwnershipAcquisitionPending rejection, local knowledge removal, retained federation-wide object state, and rediscovery. The focused filesystem-report test proves a rejected unknown-object call appends nothing and an accepted one-argument call appends its type-37 ObjectInstanceHandle record after the local-forget transition. A timestamped companion proves the same public service suppresses a queued timestamped reflection after local knowledge is removed, while a later eligible subscription can rediscover and receive a new update. A matching timestamped object-deletion companion proves the same local-forget operation suppresses only that recipient's queued Remove Object Instance while an independent survivor still receives the removal before its grant. Broader timestamped object deletion, DDM, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
